name: KRYPKILLE
description: Krypkille (Swedish for 'Crawl Kille') is the misere (losing) variant of the traditional Swedish card game Kille (or Harlekin). Played with a unique 42-card Kille deck, the objective is to avoid winning tricks or being left with high-penalty cards. Unlike the gambling-focused standard Kille, Krypkille is a pure avoidance game often played in social and family settings in Scandinavia.

content.text: Krypkille (Swedish for 'Crawl Kille') is the misere (losing) variant of the traditional Swedish card game Kille (or Harlekin). Played with a unique 42-card Kille deck, the objective is to avoid winning tricks or being left with high-penalty cards. Unlike the gambling-focused standard Kille, Krypkille is a pure avoidance game often played in social and family settings in Scandinavia.

Dates to the mid-18th century. Kille cards (derived from Cuckoo cards) spread throughout the Nordic countries. Krypkille developed as a way to play with the specialized deck without the high-stakes gambling of 'Enkelt' or 'Dubbelt' Kille.
